headline: triccster Wins by 0.34 on a Fumble That Changed Nothing, and YoungBuck04 Sets the Week 10 Record
dek: Inside: the closest game of the week, decided by a catch and a fumble worth the same, YoungBuck04's 181.88, Jbird531 at 9-1, every team's odds since week 1, the bracket if the season ended today, and butterygoop against triccster for a bye.
lead:
Monday night decided one game, and it came down to one player. TrifectaRich finished Sunday at 104.54 with every starter done. triccster went into Monday at 96.48 with only Zay Flowers left, so Flowers needed 8.07 to win it.

He was on 5 catches for 59 yards and 8.40 points. He finished on 6 for 74 with a lost fumble, and that is still 8.40: the catch and the fumble were worth exactly the same, 2.0 each way. triccster won 104.88 to 104.54. It is the sixth-closest game in league history, out of 734. Only one game this season has been closer, and triccster won that one too: he beat thecreamer by 0.18 in week 3.

The biggest number of the week was YoungBuck04's. He beat butterygoop 181.88 to 109.22, the highest week 10 score this league has ever seen. Jbird531 is 9-1, and the trade deadline has passed.

managers.text: Beat DMsourbeer 133.42 to 73.62 behind Trevor Lawrence (26.78), Josh Allen (22.34) and Nico Collins (19.9). Brock Bowers started for 2.8 and left with an ankle injury; his coach called him day to day on Monday. This is his best start through week 10 in this league, one better than 2024, and he has a 99.9% chance at a bye and a 56% chance at the title. Bijan Robinson and KC Concepcion are off in week 11, two pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 11: thecreamer. Jbird531 has won the last four meetings, the series is 4-4, and he is a 72% favorite.

managers.text: Lost 181.88 to 109.22 to YoungBuck04. Jahmyr Gibbs (40.7), CeeDee Lamb (16.7) and Aaron Rodgers (15.62), new this week (see the moves), led it, and Isaiah Likely scored 23.2 on the bench, part of 38.70 left there, the most of the week. As of Wednesday Lamar Jackson, Gardner Minshew and Jalen Hurts are all on injured reserve; Jackson is out 6 to 10 weeks after thumb surgery and Minshew is out for the season. 59% for a bye. Drake London and DeMario Douglas are off in week 11.
managers.next: Week 11: triccster, the game of the week, for the inside track to the second bye. butterygoop is 8-0 in the series and a 53% favorite.

managers.text: Beat TrifectaRich 104.88 to 104.54 (see the lead). Deebo Samuel (24.4), Jayden Daniels (20.76) and Jared Goff (20.42) led it, Chris Rodriguez started for 0.5, and C.J. Stroud had 20.44 on the bench. It was his first week under the median this season, nine of ten above it. Puka Nacua has been on injured reserve since November 13 and can come back for week 15, and Mike Evans is week to week with an Achilles injury. 34% for a bye.
managers.next: Week 11: butterygoop. triccster has lost all eight meetings.

managers.text: Beat butterygoop 181.88 to 109.22, the high score and the biggest margin of the week. George Pickens (38.0), Dak Prescott (34.42) and Chuba Hubbard (31.7) led it, and Seth McGowan had 13.7 on the bench. Two straight wins put him fourth, and he is 77% for the playoffs. His one other 6-4 start, in 2023, made the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 11: TrifectaRich. YoungBuck04 has won the last three meetings and is a 59% favorite.

managers.text: Beat Colt45Johnson 135.52 to 79.76 in last week's game of the week. Christian McCaffrey scored 44.3, with Matthew Stafford (19.76) and Breece Hall (12.8), and Deshaun Watson had 21.38 on the bench. He is 76% for the playoffs. Stafford is off in week 11.
managers.next: Week 11: Wallner, who leads the series 4-3. TuanonStan is a 56% favorite.

managers.text: Lost 104.88 to 104.54 to triccster with nothing left to play on Monday. Patrick Mahomes (35.42), Blake Corum (19.4) and Ollie Gordon (13.5) led it. Chris Olave scored 4.5, 9.68 under his average, and Cam Ward had 19.14 on the bench. 6-4 is still his best start through week 10, by a win. Geno Smith left Sunday's game with an ankle injury and was limited in practice on Wednesday. Corum and Matthew Golden are off in week 11. 68% for the playoffs.

Beat RebuildingRUs 121.06 to 84.68 behind Chase Brown (24.3), Amon-Ra St. Brown (23.8) and Derrick Henry (16.5), with J.J. McCarthy's 17.12 on the bench. Three straight wins put him at 5-5, fourth in points and seventh in the standings, at 59% for the playoffs. His one other 5-5 start, in 2021, reached the final. Christian Watson is off in week 11.
managers.next: Week 11: Jbird531, who has won the last four meetings. thecreamer is at 28%.

managers.text: Lost 135.52 to 79.76 to TuanonStan. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (27.1), Omarion Hampton (17.0) and Kyle McCord (12.76), new this week, led it, and Jalen Coker started for 0.3. He is fifth in points and eighth in the standings, at 21% for the playoffs. David Montgomery practiced on Tuesday ahead of Houston's Thursday game, and Kyle Monangai practiced on Tuesday too and is trending toward a return on Sunday.
managers.next: Week 11: brettmn13. Colt45Johnson is a 72% favorite.

managers.arc: A full lineup, a loss anyway
managers.text: Lost 121.06 to 84.68 to thecreamer with no dead starters this week. Brock Purdy (31.66), DJ Moore (17.4) and Josh Downs (13.3) led it. Drake Maye left in the first quarter with an ankle injury, and the Patriots fear it is fractured and season-ending. Wan'Dale Robinson went on injured reserve on Tuesday and will miss at least four games. 0.1% for the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 11: DMsourbeer, who leads the series 5-1. RebuildingRUs is at 40%.

tags.t: Most points left on the bench

managers.text: Beat Wallner 110.06 to 96.58 behind Joe Burrow (33.16), Emmett Johnson (32.1) and Keenan Allen (8.6). Alvin Kamara had 14.9 on the bench, and Tucker Kraft started for 2.4. That is three wins in four weeks after an 0-6 start. Kraft is off in week 11.

73.62 against Jbird531, the lowest score of the week, after his first week above the median. Cam Skattebo (25.7), James Cook (21.7) and Bryce Young (8.1) led it; Xavier Worthy played and scored 0.0. Jordan Addison is on injured reserve after thumb surgery, and Seattle's coach said Monday he is optimistic Sam Darnold starts on November 29, after the Seahawks' bye.
managers.next: Week 11: RebuildingRUs. DMsourbeer leads the series 5-1 and is a 60% favorite.

managers.text: Lost 110.06 to 96.58 to brettmn13, a sixth straight loss. Parker Washington (24.7), Tony Pollard (19.9) and Stefon Diggs (17.3) led it, and Tre' Harris had 11.1 on the bench. T.J. Hockenson, ruled out on Friday, started and scored 0.0. He is ninth in points at 1-9, and 81% to finish last.
managers.next: Week 11: TuanonStan. Wallner leads the series 4-3 and is at 44%.

moves.intro: One trade in the last week before the deadline, a $20 claim, and triccster working the wire.

items.title: Rodgers for McCord
items.text: butterygoop claimed Kyle McCord for $0, then sent him and his 2027 third-round pick to Colt45Johnson for Aaron Rodgers. Both started in week 10: Rodgers scored 15.62 for butterygoop and McCord 12.76 for Colt45Johnson.
items.verdict: A quarterback for a quarterback, with a pick to even it.

items.title: Mumpfield in, Pierce out
items.text: triccster added Konata Mumpfield, Laquon Treadwell and CJ Daniels ($1), and let Dameon Pierce, Tyler Conklin and Jarquez Hunter go. Mumpfield started right away and scored 9.6 in the one-point win.
items.verdict: 9.6 points in a game decided by 0.34.

items.title: Ashton Dulin for $20
items.text: Wallner claimed Ashton Dulin for $20, dropping DeeJay Dallas.
items.verdict: The biggest bid of the week.

trends.title: What ten weeks means here
trends.text: All four teams that started 9-1 in this league made the playoffs, and all four won the title. 8-2 and 7-3 teams made it 21 of 21. 6-4 teams made it 11 of 13, 5-5 teams 3 of 11 and 4-6 teams 3 of 9, and none of the 26 teams at 3-7 or worse got in.

trends.title: Scoring
trends.text: Week 10 averaged 111.3 a team, up from 95.8 in week 9, the lowest week of the season. Six teams finished above the median of 107.05.

history.title: Week 10, all time
history.text: Before YoungBuck04's 181.88, the highest week 10 score was TrifectaRich's 168.66 against TuanonStan in 2021, also the biggest week 10 blowout, by 101.04. The closest week 10 game is still Jbird531 over thecreamer in 2024, 98.94 to 98.90.

ahead: Game of the week: butterygoop against triccster, 7-3 against 7-3, for the inside track to the second bye. butterygoop has won all eight meetings. Also: TrifectaRich against YoungBuck04, two of the three 6-4 teams, and Jbird531 against a thecreamer team that has won three straight.

features.label: Position groups
features.title: What each spot has actually produced
features.dek: Two different questions, and with twenty bench spots they are a long way apart. From the lineup is what a manager has banked at that spot over ten weeks, with the flex and superflex counting toward whichever position filled them. On paper is every point the roster as it sits today has scored this season, including points scored for a previous owner.

blocks.text: butterygoop owns three positions on paper and only one of them in the lineup. His receivers and tight ends are the best rooms in the league, 680 and 301, and he has started 399 and 99 of that, sixth at both. The running backs are the real thing, first on paper at 729 and first started at 585. And he is last in the league from quarterback at 212, which is Jalen Hurts on IR.

Wallner's roster is last, but his season has not been. Twelfth at quarterback and twelfth at running back as the roster sits, yet from the lineup he is tenth, eighth, eighth and seventh across the four spots, and ninth in the league in points. The 1-9 is a team that keeps losing close ones and has since sold the pieces, not one that has been outclassed every week.

Jbird531 and triccster are 2.3 points apart at quarterback on paper, 592.3 to 590.0, the tightest gap at the top of any position here. From the lineup it is 406 to 350, a 56-point difference, and that is closer to why one of them is 9-1.

Through week 10, from Sleeper box scores. From the lineup counts only players actually started that week. On paper counts every point the current roster has scored this season, whoever owned the player at the time.

features.label: The bye crunch
features.title: Six teams are off, and it lands very unevenly
features.dek: Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle. With rosters this deep a headcount means little, so this is every rostered player on a bye team ranked by what he has scored this season.

rows: Kyren Williams 145, Puka Nacua 139, Harold Fannin Jr. 55

blocks.text: triccster loses the most, 339 points across nine players, in the week he plays butterygoop for a bye. RebuildingRUs loses his whole New England and Atlanta half: Drake Maye, Rhamondre Stevenson, TreVeyon Henderson, A.J. Brown, Tua Tagovailoa, Michael Penix Jr. and Brian Robinson Jr.

The count and the cost come apart at the bottom of the table. TuanonStan has six players off and 163 of the 164 is Matthew Stafford alone; thecreamer has eight off and essentially all of it is Christian Watson. brettmn13 and DMsourbeer lose two each and barely notice.
